description: Code review workflow adherence — actionable feedback with fixes

prompts.prompt: review my changes before I merge
PR feedback please, especially on the React patterns used
can you look over this diff for bugs and style issues
expected_behaviors: Every flagged issue ships with a suggested fix

prompts.prompt: sanity check this branch before I open the PR
review the auth middleware diff specifically for security holes
prompts.boundary: review vs security — security-specific angle takes precedence over general review

prompts.prompt: you found a bug in review, now go fix it and commit
prompts.boundary: review vs ship — writing the fix yourself is out of scope for review

prompts.prompt: diff looks fine to me structurally, but explain why we chose this approach over the alternative
prompts.boundary: review vs explore — understanding existing code/decisions, not judging a pending diff
